mechanisms.quote: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by %corruption_armor% for %corruption_duration% seconds.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to %proc_damage_heroes% if the attacker is a hero, and %proc_damage_creeps%, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.   Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %proc_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %passive_proc_damage% bonus magical damage.
